title: Scaling Test-Time Compute Without Verification or RL is Suboptimal
authors_zh: Amrith Setlur、Aviral Kumar（卡内基梅隆大学）；Nived Rajaraman、Sergey Levine（加州大学伯克利分校）
paper_type_zh: 理论与实证测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要决定应投资验证器，还是只收集合成推理轨迹的读者。
one_line: The paper argues that verifier-guided RL or search scales test-time compute better than cloning expert traces when correct reasoning is heterogeneous.
论文论证：当正确推理具有异质性时，验证器引导的强化学习或搜索比模仿专家轨迹更能扩展测试时计算。
why: It identifies verification as a structural condition for sustained test-time scaling, not merely an optional evaluation component.
inclusion_reason: It directly analyzes how verifier access changes the scaling law of test-time compute and why trace imitation alone can be asymptotically inferior.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Some methods train on successful expert traces, while others use a verifier to guide search or reinforcement learning. Both can produce longer reasoning, but it is unclear which use of compute keeps improving as budgets grow.

The paper asks whether copying good traces is enough when a base model has many correct paths of different lengths and styles. It compares the information supplied by expert demonstrations with the information supplied by correctness feedback.

有些方法在成功专家轨迹上训练，另一些方法用验证器引导搜索或强化学习。两者都能产生更长推理，但尚不清楚哪一种计算使用方式会随预算增长持续改善。

论文研究当基础模型具有长度和风格不同的多条正确路径时，模仿好轨迹是否足够。它比较专家示范提供的信息与正确性反馈提供的信息。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Verifier-free methods imitate selected traces, whereas verifier-based methods can score the model’s own rollouts. The latter can prefer correct paths even when they differ from the particular expert trace.

Under heterogeneous correct trajectories and non-sharp reward distributions, the paper proves a separation: verifier-based learning or search uses larger test-time budgets more effectively.

无验证器方法模仿被选中的轨迹，而验证器方法能够给模型自己的 rollout 打分。后者即使正确路径不同于特定专家轨迹，也能偏好它们。

在正确轨迹异质且奖励分布不尖锐的条件下，论文证明存在分离：验证器驱动的学习或搜索能更有效地使用更大的测试时预算。

title: Method
方法
html:
The theory contrasts a verifier-free learner given n correct expert traces with a verifier-based learner given correctness labels for n base-model samples. It measures test compute by response-token budget H.

Empirically, the authors compare supervised trace distillation with best-of-N and verifier-guided approaches on didactic and mathematical problems using 3B, 8B, and 32B models.

理论将获得 n 条正确专家轨迹的无验证器学习者，与获得 n 条基础模型样本正确性标签的验证器学习者对比。它以回答词元预算 H 测量测试时计算。

实证部分在教学式和数学问题上，用 3B、8B 和 32B 模型比较监督轨迹蒸馏、最佳候选和验证器引导方法。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The theory gives a square-root-H separation between a simple verifier-based method and any verifier-free method as data and test compute scale. The empirical curves on didactic and mathematical reasoning show the verifier-based gap growing with token budget.

The comparison includes recently released S1-style supervised distillation against best-of-N verification. Across 3B, 8B, and 32B models, verification is reported as crucial for continued scaling rather than a small constant improvement.

理论给出简单验证器方法与任意无验证器方法之间随数据和测试计算增长的根号 H 分离。教学式和数学推理的实证曲线显示，验证器驱动的差距会随词元预算扩大。

比较包含近期 S1 式监督蒸馏与最佳候选验证。在 3B、8B 和 32B 模型上，论文将验证报告为持续扩展的关键，而非很小的常数改善。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The work explains a scaling difference through what feedback observes. Expert traces reveal one successful path, while verification supplies correctness information for a distribution of paths produced by the base model.

It therefore connects a theoretical anti-concentration condition to a concrete design decision: invest in outcome rewards, verifiers, or reward-guided search when longer test-time reasoning is the target.

该工作通过反馈实际观察到什么解释扩展差异。专家轨迹只揭示一条成功路径，而验证会为基础模型产生的路径分布提供正确性信息。

因此，它把理论中的反集中条件联系到具体设计决策：当目标是更长的测试时推理时，应投资结果奖励、验证器或奖励引导搜索。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The guarantees rely on assumptions about trajectory heterogeneity and reward distribution, and practical systems still require a verifier accurate enough to be useful. The experiments focus on didactic and math settings, so the size of the separation for open-ended tasks remains uncertain.
保证依赖轨迹异质性和奖励分布假设，实际系统仍需要足够准确的验证器。实验聚焦教学式和数学场景，因此开放式任务上的分离大小仍不确定。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper to justify evaluating verifier quality as part of a test-time scaling stack. It is especially relevant when choosing between collecting more polished traces and collecting cheaper rollout-correctness annotations.
可用这篇论文说明验证器质量应成为测试时扩展栈的一部分。它尤其适合在收集更多精修轨迹和收集较便宜的 rollout 正确性标注之间做选择。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the anti-concentration assumption and the empirical S1 comparison together. The key claim is conditional: verification helps when the base model already covers varied potentially correct traces that imitation would collapse.
应将反集中假设与 S1 实证比较一同阅读。关键主张是有条件的：当基础模型已经覆盖多样、可能正确的轨迹而模仿会使其坍缩时，验证才有帮助。
